artifacts.summary: Recommends repointing all 12 opencode-agents.json fragments' {file:...} references at .claude/agents/<agent>.md (Option a), degrading merge.lua's validator to report-all/per-key instead of fail-fast/per-fragment, and flags a content-mismatch caveat plus a partially-diverged .opencode/extensions/ mirror that a future sync task must reconcile.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's extension system, opencode.json generation (merge.lua generate_opencode_json) is gated behind a project-root opencode.json.managed sidecar file — if that marker is absent, the whole opencode fragment validation/merge path is a no-op, regardless of which extensions are loaded or active. Useful when debugging why opencode-related warnings appear in one consuming repo but not another.

The extension system has two parallel, parameterized deploy profiles (lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/config.lua M.claude() and M.opencode()), each with its own base_dir, agents_subdir, and source-of-truth global_extensions_dir. M.opencode()'s source is .opencode/extensions/ (an absolute, global path under ~/.config/nvim), NOT agent-system/extensions/ (which is M.claude()'s source). Code that reads {file:...} literal path strings from opencode-agents.json fragments resolves them relative to project_dir regardless of which profile triggered the call, so a fragment's path convention must match whatever gets deployed under the profile that actually invokes it, not the other profile.

.opencode/extensions/ is a second, git-tracked (not gitignored) mirror of the same extensions found in agent-system/extensions/, predating the migration that made agent-system/extensions/ canonical. It has independently diverged for at least nix (self-contained {file:.opencode/extensions/<ext>/agents/<name>.md} path convention) and present (already-correct slides-research agent key, absent the stale 'slides' bug found in the canonical copy) — meaning the canonical store is not strictly ahead of the mirror, and a one-directional sync would regress already-fixed mirror content for those extensions.
